        - paragraph: Every complex number can be written in polar form.

        - paragraph:

        - paragraph:
          - generic: Quotient

        - paragraph:
          - generic: Power
          - generic: zⁿ = |z|ⁿ cis(nθ)
        - paragraph:
          - generic: Conjugate
          - generic: z̄ = |z| cis(−θ)
